representative_flow.input: My order #4821 arrived in red, but I ordered blue. I need it before Friday for a birthday. Send the replacement today.

policy_matches.title: Wrong or damaged item
policy_matches.content: Request the order number and a description of the problem. A replacement or reshipment requires inventory confirmation and human approval. Do not guarantee a delivery date before the carrier option is confirmed.

output.recommended_action: Verify the order, problem description, stock and shipping options before approving a replacement.
output.approval_reason: Replacement requires stock confirmation; Time-sensitive delivery promise
output.draft_reply: I’m sorry about the item you received. Please share your order number and a description of the problem. A team member must confirm stock and available shipping options before approving a replacement or delivery date.
